# Registry seed for `scen-check-fix-by-crush`.
#
# The seed of scen-check-fix-adds-measurable-criterion, walked with every
# tier naming crush: one Scenario that names no exact message, count, code
# or threshold anywhere. crush answers in the delimited FILE block, asks
# which criterion in the QUESTIONS block, then writes the fix.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-22"
  description: "One scenario with no measurable criterion"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must greet the person whose name it is given
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories: []
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured
      when:
        - the Operator runs the greeter with a name
      then:
        - the greeter outputs the exact message "Hello, <name>!" where <name> is the name given in the When step
